mapper.select: select target_id, count(*) as comment_count from blog_comment where target_type = #{targetType} and deleted_at = 0 and review = 0 group by target_id
mapper.insert: insert into blog_comment (user_id, target_id, target_type, content, parent_id, reply_user_id, ip_region, review, deleted_at, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{targetId}, #{targetType}, #{content}, #{parentId}, #{replyUserId}, #{ipRegion}, #{review}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
